phonemes.text: Seventy-three seconds after launch, on January 28, 1986, the Space Shuttle Challenger broke apart.
phonemes.ipa: sˈɛvəntiθɹˈiː sˈɛkəndz ˈæftɚ lˈɑːntʃ ˌɔn dʒˈænjuːˌɛɹi twˈɛnti ˈeɪt nˈaɪntiːnhˈʌndɹɪd ˈeɪɾi sˈɪks ðə spˈeɪs ʃˈʌɾəl tʃˈælɪndʒɚ bɹˈoʊk ɐpˈɑːɹt

phonemes.text: Seven people died.
phonemes.ipa: sˈɛvən pˈiːpəl dˈaɪd

phonemes.text: The night before, a group of engineers had tried to stop the launch with a chart.
phonemes.ipa: ðə nˈaɪt bᵻfˌɔːɹ ɐ ɡɹˈuːp ʌv ˌɛndʒɪnˈɪɹz hæd tɹˈaɪd tə stˈɑːp ðə lˈɑːntʃ wɪð ɐ tʃˈɑːɹt

phonemes.text: This is the story of the chart they drew, the chart they could have drawn, and the difference between them.
phonemes.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ðə stˈɔːɹi ʌvðə tʃˈɑːɹt ðeɪ dɹˈuː ðə tʃˈɑːɹt ðeɪ kˌʊdɐv dɹˈɔːn ænd ðə dˈɪfɹəns bᵻtwˈiːn ðˌɛm

phonemes.text: On the evening of January 27, engineers at Morton Thiokol, the contractor that built the solid rocket boosters, joined a teleconference with NASA.
phonemes.ipa: ɔnðɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ ʌv dʒˈænjuːˌɛɹi twˈɛnti sˈɛvən ˌɛndʒɪnˈɪɹz æt mˈɔːɹtən θˌaɪoʊkˈɑːl ðə kəntɹˈæktɚ ðæt bˈɪlt ðə sˈɑːlɪd ɹˈɑːkɪt bˈuːstɚz dʒˈɔɪnd ɐ tˈɛlᵻkˌɑːnfɚɹəns wɪð nˈæsɐ

phonemes.text: Their concern was the rubber O-rings that sealed the booster joints.
phonemes.ipa: ðɛɹ kənsˈɜːn wʌzðə ɹˈʌbɚɹ ˈoʊɹˈɪŋz ðæt sˈiːld ðə bˈuːstɚ dʒˈɔɪnts

phonemes.text: Cold makes rubber stiff.
phonemes.ipa: kˈoʊld mˌeɪks ɹˈʌbɚ stˈɪf

phonemes.text: Here is the kind of evidence they had: every flight on which an O-ring had shown damage, plotted against the temperature at launch.
phonemes.ipa: hˈɪɹ ɪz ðə kˈaɪnd ʌv ˈɛvɪdəns ðeɪ hæd ˈɛvɹi flˈaɪt ˌɔn wˌɪtʃ ɐn ˈoʊɹˈɪŋ hæd ʃˈoʊn dˈæmɪdʒ plˈɑːɾᵻd ɐɡˈɛnst ðə tˈɛmpɹɪtʃɚɹ æt lˈɑːntʃ

phonemes.text: Seven flights.
phonemes.ipa: sˈɛvən flˈaɪts

phonemes.text: The coldest, at fifty-three degrees, had the most damage.
phonemes.ipa: ðə kˈoʊldɪst æt fˈɪftiθɹˈiː dᵻɡɹˈiːz hæd ðə mˈoʊst dˈæmɪdʒ

phonemes.text: The rest scatter from the high fifties to seventy-five.
phonemes.ipa: ðə ɹˈɛst skˈæɾɚ fɹʌmðə hˈaɪ fˈɪftiz tə sˈɛvəntifˈaɪv

phonemes.text: Managers looked at this and saw no clear trend.
phonemes.ipa: mˈænɪdʒɚz lˈʊkt æt ðɪs ænd sˈɔː nˈoʊ klˈɪɹ tɹˈɛnd

phonemes.text: Now add what was left out.
phonemes.ipa: nˈaʊ ˈæd wʌt wʌz lˈɛft ˈaʊt

phonemes.text: Sixteen flights had launched with no O-ring damage at all.
phonemes.ipa: sˈɪkstiːn flˈaɪts hæd lˈɑːntʃt wɪð nˈoʊ ˈoʊɹˈɪŋ dˈæmɪdʒ æɾ ˈɔːl

phonemes.text: Every one of them was warm: sixty-six degrees or higher.
phonemes.ipa: ˈɛvɹi wˈʌn ʌv ðˌɛm wʌz wˈɔːɹm sˈɪkstisˈɪks dᵻɡɹˈiːz ɔːɹ hˈaɪɚ

phonemes.text: Put the zeros back and the picture changes.
phonemes.ipa: pˌʊt ðə zˈiəɹoʊz bˈæk ænd ðə pˈɪktʃɚ tʃˈeɪndʒᵻz

phonemes.text: Damage is not random.
phonemes.ipa: dˈæmɪdʒ ɪz nˌɑːt ɹˈændəm

phonemes.text: It lives at the cold end.
phonemes.ipa: ɪt lˈɪvz æt ðə kˈoʊld ˈɛnd

phonemes.text: Statisticians later fitted a simple model to these twenty-three flights: the chance that an O-ring is damaged as a function of temperature.
phonemes.ipa: stˌæɾɪstˈɪʃənz lˈeɪɾɚ fˈɪɾᵻd ɐ sˈɪmpəl mˈɑːdəl tə ðiːz twˈɛntiθɹˈiː flˈaɪts ðə tʃˈæns ðæt ɐn ˈoʊɹˈɪŋ ɪz dˈæmɪdʒd æz ɐ fˈʌŋkʃən ʌv tˈɛmpɹɪtʃɚ

phonemes.text: Fit the same model to the public table, and the curve climbs steeply below sixty degrees.
phonemes.ipa: fˈɪt ðə sˈeɪm mˈɑːdəl tə ðə pˈʌblɪk tˈeɪbəl ænd ðə kˈɜːv klˈaɪmz stˈiːpli bᵻlˌoʊ sˈɪksti dᵻɡɹˈiːz

phonemes.text: At fifty-three degrees, the coldest launch so far, it expects about three damaged rings out of six.
phonemes.ipa: æt fˈɪftiθɹˈiː dᵻɡɹˈiːz ðə kˈoʊldɪst lˈɑːntʃ sˈoʊ fˌɑːɹ ɪɾ ɛkspˈɛkts ɐbˌaʊt θɹˈiː dˈæmɪdʒd ɹˈɪŋz ˌaʊɾəv sˈɪks

phonemes.text: At the thirty-six degrees recorded on the pad that morning, it expects nearly all six.
phonemes.ipa: æt ðə θˈɜːɾisˈɪks dᵻɡɹˈiːz ɹᵻkˈɔːɹdᵻd ɔnðə pˈæd ðæt mˈɔːɹnɪŋ ɪɾ ɛkspˈɛkts nˌɪɹli ˈɔːl sˈɪks

phonemes.text: The engineers' recommendation that night was to not launch below fifty-three degrees.
phonemes.ipa: ðɪ ˌɛndʒɪnˈɪɹz ɹˌɛkəmɛndˈeɪʃən ðæt nˈaɪt wʌz tə nˌɑːt lˈɑːntʃ bᵻlˌoʊ fˈɪftiθɹˈiː dᵻɡɹˈiːz

phonemes.text: NASA managers pushed back on the recommendation.
phonemes.ipa: nˈæsɐ mˈænɪdʒɚz pˈʊʃt bˈæk ɔnðə ɹˌɛkəmɛndˈeɪʃən

phonemes.text: Thiokol's management took the call offline for about thirty minutes, returned, and overruled its own engineers.
phonemes.ipa: θˌaɪoʊkˈɑːlz mˈænɪdʒmənt tˈʊk ðə kˈɔːl ˈɔflaɪn fɔːɹ ɐbˌaʊt θˈɜːɾi mˈɪnɪts ɹᵻtˈɜːnd ænd ˌoʊvɚɹˈuːld ɪts ˈoʊn ˌɛndʒɪnˈɪɹz

phonemes.text: The launch went ahead.
phonemes.ipa: ðə lˈɑːntʃ wɛnt ɐhˈɛd

phonemes.text: The Presidential Commission later traced the failure to the O-ring seal in the aft field joint of the right solid rocket booster, with cold temperature among the causes.
phonemes.ipa: ðə pɹˌɛzɪdˈɛnʃəl kəmˈɪʃən lˈeɪɾɚ tɹˈeɪst ðə fˈeɪlɪɹ tə ðɪ ˈoʊɹˈɪŋ sˈiːl ɪnðɪ ˈæft fˈiːld dʒˈɔɪnt ʌvðə ɹˈaɪt sˈɑːlɪd ɹˈɑːkɪt bˈuːstɚ wɪð kˈoʊld tˈɛmpɹɪtʃɚɹ ɐmˌʌŋ ðə kˈɔːzᵻz

phonemes.text: The mistake has a name.
phonemes.ipa: ðə mɪstˈeɪk hɐz ɐ nˈeɪm

phonemes.text: The engineers selected on the outcome: they plotted only the flights where damage had occurred.
phonemes.ipa: ðɪ ˌɛndʒɪnˈɪɹz sᵻlˈɛktᵻd ɔnðɪ ˈaʊtkʌm ðeɪ plˈɑːɾᵻd ˈoʊnli ðə flˈaɪts wˌɛɹ dˈæmɪdʒ hæd əkˈɜːd

phonemes.text: That throws away the comparison group.
phonemes.ipa: ðæt θɹˈoʊz ɐwˈeɪ ðə kəmpˈæɹɪsən ɡɹˈuːp

phonemes.text: Without the flights that went fine, there is nothing for the damaged flights to be different from.
phonemes.ipa: wɪðˌaʊt ðə flˈaɪts ðæt wɛnt fˈaɪn ðɛɹ ɪz nˈʌθɪŋ fɚðə dˈæmɪdʒd flˈaɪts təbi dˈɪfɹənt fɹʌm

phonemes.text: In 1989, three statisticians published a risk analysis using only the data available before the launch.
phonemes.ipa: ɪn nˈaɪntiːnhˈʌndɹɪd ˈeɪɾi nˈaɪn θɹˈiː stˌæɾɪstˈɪʃənz pˈʌblɪʃt ɐ ɹˈɪsk ɐnˈæləsˌɪs jˈuːzɪŋ ˈoʊnli ðə dˈeɪɾə ɐvˈeɪləbəl bᵻfˌɔːɹ ðə lˈɑːntʃ

phonemes.text: Their conclusion was that the probability of failure near freezing was very high.
phonemes.ipa: ðɛɹ kəŋklˈuːʒən wʌz ðætðə pɹˌɑːbəbˈɪlᵻɾi ʌv fˈeɪlɪɹ nˌɪɹ fɹˈiːzɪŋ wʌz vˈɛɹi hˈaɪ

phonemes.text: Edward Tufte later made the same point about the charts themselves: the evidence existed; the display failed to show it.
phonemes.ipa: ˈɛdwɚd tˈʌft lˈeɪɾɚ mˌeɪd ðə sˈeɪm pˈɔɪnt ɐbˌaʊt ðə tʃˈɑːɹts ðɛmsˈɛlvz ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns ɛɡzˈɪstᵻd ðə dɪsplˈeɪ fˈeɪld tə ʃˈoʊ ɪt

phonemes.text: Twenty-three rows and two columns.
phonemes.ipa: twˈɛntiθɹˈiː ɹˈoʊz ænd tˈuː kˈɑːlʌmz

phonemes.text: Shown in full, they told the truth.
phonemes.ipa: ʃˈoʊn ɪn fˈʊl ðeɪ tˈoʊld ðə tɹˈuːθ

phonemes.text: Shown in part, they said nothing at all.
phonemes.ipa: ʃˈoʊn ɪn pˈɑːɹt ðeɪ sˈɛd nˈʌθɪŋ æɾ ˈɔːl
